title: 三腕式回転ゲート
description: 台座、機構ケース、接続された3本の回転腕を備える物理的な通行ゲート。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: An unbranded mechanical tripod turnstile with anchored pedestal, mechanism cabinet and three connected radial arms. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
